o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *ökte- (“to infuse pride, courage; pride, proud, courageous”). Cognate with Kyrgyz өктөм (öktöm, “violent, unbridled, vehement”).
Present participle compound of istilik (“heat”) + ölçmək (“to measure”). Ultimately a calque of French thermomètre. Compare Turkish sıcaklıkölçer (uncommon, puristic).
From Persian ناخوش (nâxoš). By surface analysis, na- + xoş.
From Proto-Turkic *yama- (“to patch”). Cognate with Turkish yamamak, Bashkir ямау (yamaw), see it for more cognates.
Ultimately a calque of Arabic الشُّكْرُ لِلّٰهِ (aš-šukru lillāhi, “thank God”, literally “gratitude to God”).
